purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official NCA viewer describes a public GIS for State Land Cadastre spatial data. Anonymous WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200 and lists the `pcm:…` land-parcels layer; anonymous DescribeFeatureType returned HTTP 200 and confirms a full polygon geometry field. The schema also contains address and organization attributes, so the bounded WUP-point GetFeature request was restricted to `geom` only, but the server closed that request without a response. No owner/address fields or credential headers were requested or retained.
registryAssessment: The Belarus National Cadastral Agency public map exposes a named land-parcels WFS layer and geometry schema from the state cadastral system.
